purpose: Downstream query-building gates. NOT classifier thresholds: the frozen C4 decisions are unchanged; a gate only decides whether a classifier-positive finding enters a retrieval query.
derived_from: classifier VALIDATION outputs only (C2-B scores, frozen C5 calibration, frozen C4 decisions); locked classifier test set not used; no retrieval result used

principle.criterion: F_beta with beta=0.5 (precision counts twice as much as recall) to reduce false-positive propagation
principle.candidates: calibrated-probability quantiles [np.float64(0.0), np.float64(0.05), np.float64(0.1), np.float64(0.15), np.float64(0.2), np.float64(0.25), np.float64(0.3), np.float64(0.35), np.float64(0.4), np.float64(0.45), np.float64(0.5), np.float64(0.55), np.float64(0.6), np.float64(0.65), np.float64(0.7), np.float64(0.75), np.float64(0.8), np.float64(0.85), np.float64(0.9), np.float64(0.95)] of the frozen-positive validation images of each class (quantile 0 = operating point)
principle.adoption_rule: adopt the best candidate only if it is stricter than the operating point AND its cross-fitted (5-fold patient-level, seed 42) F_0.5 gain has a 95% patient-bootstrap lower bound > 0; otherwise no gate (finding passes unchanged)

no_finding: not gated (it is not a pathology query term)
